periods.summary: B.B. joins Or-Gaule's breakaway faction and appears at Rebellion headquarters after Ein has killed the remaining Apostles, childishly trying to eat her bloody flowers. At Caldia he suddenly manifests as a thirty-meter giant, crushes the helicopter carrying Ikki and Milialia, and throws slabs of road like toys, killing soldiers. Ikki blinds one eye and lures him away from central avenue; after electric wires slow him, B.B. grows to over three hundred meters and nearly stomps Ikki. Alice Ascaride stops the stomp through Unbreakable, cuts his foot, then removes her helmet and scolds him. Because B.B. is mentally a five-year-old child, he apologizes and flees in tears.

periods.summary: After Naseem scatters the Vermillion team, B.B. enlarges to roughly three hundred meters and tries to crush Ikki as he falls. Ikki survives using his jacket and B.B.'s own wind pressure, then tries to stop the fight by intimidating and persuading him. B.B. initially trembles like a child before an adult, but overcomes fear because he wants to protect Or-Gaule, whom he calls his friend. Ikki accepts that B.B. is acting by his own will and fights him as a man, while also intending to teach him that bad friends bring trouble. B.B. repeatedly punches and body-slams Ikki, but his huge size becomes a disadvantage: Ikki hides in enlarged gaps like finger spaces and the navel depression, then exploits B.B.'s slow tracking. Ikki cuts the Achilles and quadriceps tendons and finishes with Rhino Strike to the temple, disrupting B.B.'s motor control without killing him. As B.B. tries to bite, Ikki touches his cheek and tells him to grow up, learn what he and his power mean, and meet again as an adult. The warm touch stirs vague memories of loving parents before the child was taken by cruel adults. B.B. shrinks and sleeps with a peaceful child's face.

key_events.summary: Is defeated nonlethally by Ikki after declaring he fights to protect Or-Gaule.
